text: ok cool. one thing need to do is update all the physics rects also [Image #5]
resolution: Physics rects now follow the resized props. The clip in the user's screenshot was the dumpster: physics still blocked the old 1.8m footprint SQUARE while the body renders 2.07m wide x 1.56m deep after PROPSCALE-0611. Fixed at the root per rule-of-two: the body box is defined ONCE in the registry (propKinds.dumpsterBodyMeters() + DUMPSTER_AUTHORED_HEIGHT) and consumed by all three users — world/props.ts propFootprint (dumpster now gets a yaw-aware rotated-rect AABB like the fence family), render3d/props/Dumpster.tsx, and compile/worldGeometry.ts — so the box you see is exactly the box you bump. Audited the rest of the rect layer: every other solid prop's rect already derives live from footprintRadius/heightMeters (so the scale sweep flowed through automatically, including tree trunks and the kicked-body radii), and the SEGMENT_HALF_THICKNESS table (fence/barrier/bench/couch/beds/cupboard) was re-verified against its models — all still match. navGrid and placementCheck inherit via propFootprint. 7 suites green (86 cases), cart bundle clean.
